decisions.decision: Fixed geofenceRegistrationControllerProvider having zero callers anywhere in the app by adding a container.read() call in main.dart's startup block (commit 3153e43)
decisions.rationale: Riverpod providers only run build() when read/watched; nothing in the codebase referenced this provider outside its own file and unit test, so native registration was structurally dead code despite passing unit tests. Mirrors the existing pattern for pushServiceControllerProvider/quickActionsServiceProvider already in main.dart. Documented as a plan deviation (files_modified was declared empty).
